advice.headline: Stay the course
reasons: You're 7-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 13%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 4th of 10 contenders (145.7 points a week).
Your weakest position is RB (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 13%, 23%, 20%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.
We tested the best fair trade with 6 teams and none clearly raises your title chance beyond the simulation's margin (about 2 points).
Re-check before the deadline (4 weeks left): injuries change this quickly.
watch: Week 14 is your weakest projected week (155 points vs your usual 172), mostly byes.
Rhamondre Stevenson may be worth more now than later: age 28: RB values usually drop after this season.
Jayden Daniels's trade value has dropped 14% in 21 days.
Lamar Jackson's trade value has dropped 28% in 21 days.
Isaiah Likely's trade value has dropped 40% in 21 days.
